Plugin.Name: RTX 3090 Unlock
Plugin.Overview: Restores full-rate FP16/BF16 Tensor Core instruction issue on NVIDIA GA102/GA104 GPUs (tested on RTX 3090) by loading Zagitta's gpu_unlock module before the NVIDIA driver. Experimental: modifies boot options and loads a kernel module. Back up your boot flash first.
Plugin.Description:
Unraid packaging of [Zagitta's GPU Unlock](https://github.com/Zagitta/gpu-unlock). Tested on an RTX 3090 with Unraid 7.3.4 (kernel 6.18.58-Unraid); other GPUs and Unraid versions are experimental.
- Requires the NVIDIA Driver plugin and a GA102 or GA104 GPU available to the host. - Ships one prebuilt GPL module for 6.18.58-Unraid; other kernels need a matching module staged before installation (see the project README). - Every download is SHA-256 verified. The installer never reboots the server or resets the GPU; restart when convenient. - On a kernel mismatch the plugin stays installed, loads the normal NVIDIA driver and shows a notification. - Uninstall restores the boot options it manages.
Verify after reboot with `dmesg | grep -i gpu_unlock` (look for "gpu_unlock: unlocked"). No warranty; not affiliated with Unraid or NVIDIA.
